narration.text: One earthquake ruptured 1,300 kilometres of seafloor.
The shaking lasted at least ten minutes.
Its magnitude is estimated at 9.1 to 9.3.
Waves reached up to 30 metres high.
In total, 227,898 people died across the Indian Ocean.
Seismic waves crossed the planet in about 22 minutes.
The Indian Ocean had no tsunami warning system then.
So the deadliest part of a tsunami is the time without warning.
